CONVICT.gloss: a person serving a sentence in a jail or prison
CONVICT.definition: A person serving a sentence in a jail or prison.

TONIC.gloss: lime- or lemon-flavored carbonated water containing quinine
TONIC.definition: Lime- or lemon-flavored carbonated water containing quinine.

CONIC.gloss: a curve generated by the intersection of a plane and a circular cone
CONIC.definition: (geometry) a curve generated by the intersection of a plane and a circular cone.

COIN.gloss: a flat metal piece used as money
COIN.definition: A flat metal piece (usually a disc) used as money.

ICON.definition: (computer science) a graphic symbol (usually a simple picture) that denotes a program or a command or a data file or a concept in a graphical user interface.

NOT.gloss: negation of a word or group of words
NOT.definition: Negation of a word or group of words.

TON.definition: A United States unit of weight equivalent to 2000 pounds.

CON.gloss: an argument opposed to a proposal
CON.definition: An argument opposed to a proposal.

ION.gloss: a particle that is electrically charged
ION.definition: A particle that is electrically charged (positive or negative); an atom or molecule or group that has lost or gained one or more electrons.

TIN.gloss: a silvery malleable metallic element that resists corrosion
TIN.definition: A silvery malleable metallic element that resists corrosion; used in many alloys and to coat other metals to prevent corrosion; obtained chiefly from cassiterite where it occurs as tin oxide.
